text:
claire: Quick thread — slim two-email launch drip for the inference benchmark webinar. Priorities: short copy, single CTA, timezone-safe sends.

maria: I can run ops. Segments: 'signup_14d', 'trial_heavy_7d', 'opened_no_reg' (watchlist). Each gets tailored subject + template.

deen: Cadence suggestion: Day0 invite -> Day3 reminder. For trial_heavy swap Day3 for a technical brief with 2 CTAs (register + TL;DR).

lia: I'll prepare a lightweight hero (600x150 @40KB), a mobile banner, and a text-only template. No GIFs except trial_heavy.

maria: A/B test subject lines for signup_14d only. Examples:
S1: "Live benchmark: cut inference spend by 3x"
S2: "See the benchmark data + live Q&A"
Preview text short. UTM: `utm_source=news&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=bench_3135`.

ops-bot: seg-create: seg_3135_signup, seg_3135_trial, seg_3135_watch created and ready.

campaign-bot: campaign-draft created; id=cmp_3135; owner=maria; status=draft.

claire: Key metrics: open rate, click->register, register->attend, demo-request, and CPL by cohort. Also watch deliverability for lapsed addresses.

maria: Sam will wire tracking events to the marketing dashboard. Lia, upload assets to #marketing-assets by 4pm. Deen, post copy variants by 2pm. QA tomorrow 10:30am.

claire: Tiny constraints: keep invite <=100 words, use 3 bullets max, and include an .ics calendar link for the watchlist nudge. Thanks everyone.
